scope: Separate annual-template audit: localize September AVA road-closure holds. Every emitted polyline segment must remain more than 20 m from the exact OSM closure corridor. Hold both Uerkenbrücke–Engelplatz directions pending detour and source-time review. All April decisions and prior accepted paths remain unchanged; no new geometry is synthesized.

sources.role: Dated road-closure notice: 11 September 22:00 to 15 September 05:00, Isengüetlistrasse–Suhrerstrasse.

sources.role: Page 1 visually inspected. Closure and signed detour context only; no cartographic linework copied into feed geometry. Original restrictive rights statement retained in PDF.
Historical OSM ways and nodes: exact closure junctions and source corridor, not bus detour certification.

closure.method: Slice two exact historical OSM ways between the named junctions. Official map consulted for closure extent only; all coordinates are OSM.

timing.interpretation: Conservative review screen, not a legal speed limit or certification. Original minute-granularity calls are preserved without timing adjustments.
